heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P requires upgrading to a hardened steel nozzle and extruder gears before printing Bambu PLA-CF to prevent rapid abrasive wear. Once upgraded, it achieves a calculated safe maximum print speed of 190 mm/s based on an effective volumetric flow cap of 16 mm³/s.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate clean with isopropyl alcohol (no glue required)
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 16 mm³/s in the Filament Settings to prevent under-extrusion at high travel velocities.
Enable Wipe While Retracting (set wipe distance to 1.5 mm) to mitigate minor carbon fiber oozing and nozzle build-up.
Increase default infill overlap to 20% to compensate for reduced intra-layer cross-link flexibility typical of CF-filled PLA.
Configure first layer line width to 0.5 mm at 40 mm/s to ensure a solid foundation and prevent abrasive peel-up.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Severe nozzle bore expansion and inconsistent extrusion width over time
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Chopped carbon fiber strands rapidly abrade the stock P1P stainless steel nozzle orifice.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Install an official Bambu Lab hardened steel hotend assembly and hardened steel extruder gear set.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Intermittent nozzle clogs during low layer height printing
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Micro-particle agglomeration of chopped carbon fibers when layer height is set below 0.12 mm on a 0.4 mm nozzle.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Maintain a minimum layer height of 0.16 mm or switch to a 0.6 mm hardened steel nozzle profile.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Poor layer adhesion and brittle Z-axis fracture
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive cooling fan speed combined with slightly degraded, moisture-saturated PLA base resin.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the filament spool at 55°C for 8 hours and reduce max part cooling fan to 70% for dense structural components.

faq.question: Can I print Bambu PLA-CF with the stock P1P nozzle?
faq.answer: No, the stock stainless steel nozzle will quickly erode and enlarge within 200–500 grams of printing, ruining print accuracy. You must upgrade to a Bambu hardened steel nozzle and extruder gear.

faq.question: Does Bambu PLA-CF require an enclosure on the P1P?
faq.answer: No, PLA-CF does not require an enclosed chamber and prints exceptionally well in the open-frame P1P environment without warping.

faq.question: Why is the top speed capped at 190 mm/s on the P1P?
faq.answer: The filament's melt viscosity caps reliable flow at 16 mm³/s, which translates to a safe upper limit of 190 mm/s with standard 0.42 mm line width and 0.20 mm layer height.

faq.question: Can I run Bambu PLA-CF through the AMS attached to my P1P?
faq.answer: Yes, Bambu PLA-CF is explicitly engineered with refined short-strand carbon fibers to be compatible with the Bambu AMS, unlike third-party abrasive composites.
